# Reid Collins

> Senior Technical Program Manager / Software Developer in Brooklyn, NY. Hybrid background in software engineering, program leadership, and client-facing technical delivery: large-scale platform migrations, cross-functional initiatives, and scalable systems on AWS.

This site is Reid's resume and project portfolio. The pages are a client-rendered
React app; this file is the plain-text summary for agents that don't execute
JavaScript.

## About

- Current: Senior Technical Program Manager / Software Developer at Zeta Global (acquired Marigold, November 2025), 2021–2026.
- Highlights: led migrations from Phabricator to Bitbucket and on-prem Jira to Jira Cloud (20 projects, 15 teams); onboarded 100+ clients to an ML platform; drove zero-downtime Oracle-to-MySQL migration; built an AI-powered incident summarization system (Lambda, DynamoDB, Claude, Slack, Jira).
- Skills: program governance and release management; Python, Ruby, Bash; AWS (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, SageMaker, S3, Athena); MySQL, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DynamoDB; Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, distributed tracing.
- Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect – Associate; Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
- Previously: Cheetah Digital (2015–2021), CheetahMail / Experian.

## Pages

- [Resume](https://www.hihelloreid.com/): full resume with experience, skills, and an AI chatbot that answers questions about Reid's background.
- [Work](https://www.hihelloreid.com/work): index of personal AI/agent projects, each with eval coverage noted.
- [Launch Planner](https://www.hihelloreid.com/projects/launch-planner): flagship project — an agentic planner for migrations and launches. A PRD goes in, a defensible delivery plan comes out: critical-path schedule, risk log, and exec status, with an audit trail. The LLM proposes; deterministic Python validates; a human approves.
- [AI Incident Summarizer](https://www.hihelloreid.com/projects/incident-summarizer): three observability firehoses land as one incident instead of fifty pages — alerts normalized, deduplicated by fingerprint, and correlated in a time window; an LLM writes the summary that reaches Slack and Jira.
